title: ecbolium neuranthum
intro: Ecbolium neuranthum, commonly known as the "Indian spikenard", is a plant species belonging to the family Orobanchaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Ecbolium neuranthum include its ability to act as an antispasmodic, helping to relax muscles and reduce spasms, as well as its antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
